citation_detail: Plutarch, Parallel Lives, Life of Crassus. Written ca. 100–110 CE. Loeb Classical Library edition.
notes: Principal ancient source for Crassus' life. Biographical genre with moralizing elements. Exact passage references need verification.

citation_detail: Appian of Alexandria, Roman History: The Civil Wars, Books 1–2. Written ca. 150–160 CE. Loeb Classical Library edition.
notes: Covers the civil wars period. Greek historian writing under the Roman Empire. Parallel source to Plutarch.

citation_detail: Cassius Dio, Roman History, Books 39–40. Written ca. 200–230 CE. Loeb Classical Library edition.
notes: Later source, but uses earlier accounts now lost. Covers Carrhae campaign in detail.

display_name: Cicero, Letters to Atticus and Friends
citation_detail: Marcus Tullius Cicero, Epistulae ad Atticum and Epistulae ad Familiares. Contemporary to Crassus (106–43 BCE). Loeb Classical Library edition.
notes: Contemporary source. Cicero wrote letters during Crassus' lifetime. Provides firsthand perspective but Cicero was a political actor with his own biases.

citation_detail: Cadoux, T.J. 'Marcus Licinius Crassus.' In Oxford Classical Dictionary, 4th ed. Oxford University Press, 2012.
notes: Modern reference article. Adequate for basic facts but not a monograph-length treatment.

display_name: Marshall, B.A. — Crassus: A Political Biography
citation_detail: Marshall, Bruce A. Crassus: A Political Biography. Hakkert, 1976.
notes: Principal modern monograph on Crassus in English. Detailed scholarly treatment.
